description: Lendf.Me suffered a reentrancy attack via ERC777 token hooks. ERC777 tokens include a tokensReceived callback hook triggered when tokens are transferred to a contract. The attacker deposited imBTC as collateral, which triggered tokensReceived on receipt. Inside this hook, the attacker called supply() again before the first transaction completed, inflating their collateral balance. They then borrowed against the inflated collateral, draining approximately $25 million. The vulnerability lies in the protocol not following Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern when handling ERC777 token deposits.
